Bike Setup Tracker is now on Windows as well as Android. All three downloads are the same app and use the same backup files, so you can export your setups on the phone and import them on the PC, or the other way round.

| Download | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Bike-Setup-Tracker-v2.apk` | Android phones and tablets |
| `Bike-Setup-Tracker-Setup-2.0.0.exe` | Windows 10/11 (64-bit), installs with Start menu and desktop shortcuts |
| `Bike-Setup-Tracker-2.0.0-portable.exe` | Windows 10/11 (64-bit), runs from one file with nothing to install |

See the [README](https://github.com/BigDaddy284/Bike-Setup-Tracker#installing) for how to install each one. The Windows files aren't digitally signed, so on first run click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**New in this release**
- Windows desktop app (installer and portable).
- Drag a backup file onto the Windows window to import it.
- The selected profile button is now visible in the light theme.

A hobby project, offered as-is with no warranty or support.
